# Acme Notes

> The offline-first note app for people who think in Markdown.

Acme Notes is a note-taking app with Markdown, offline sync, and export. This file indexes the key
pages for language models and AI agents. (Optional: also serve /llms-full.txt with fuller text.)

## Key pages
- [Home](https://acmenotes.example/): what Acme Notes is and who it's for
- [Features](https://acmenotes.example/features): offline sync, Markdown, export, search
- [Pricing](https://acmenotes.example/pricing): Free, Pro, Teams
- [Docs](https://acmenotes.example/docs): getting started and guides
- [Blog](https://acmenotes.example/blog): tutorials and updates
- [About](https://acmenotes.example/about): team and company
- [Contact](https://acmenotes.example/contact): support

## Facts
- Platform: web, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android
- Export formats: Markdown, PDF, HTML
- Pricing: Free tier; Pro $8/mo; Teams $12/user/mo
